messages:
liam: Morning all — quick deploy-lane standup. Cut window opens in ~90m. Cherry-pick queue is 4 PRs (2 are CI flakes). I'm preparing the canary rollout, planning 10% -> 50% -> full if healthy. Blocker: flaky e2e on model-route, need infra help to repro.
olivia: I can take cherry #3 (flag toggles). Will open a review in ~20m and ping for quick eyes.
sanjay: I repro'd the e2e and got a stack trace. Pushing a fix branch now, running local CI. ETA ~45m.
maya: Heads-up: dedicated-GPU maintenance window starts in ~3h — not during cut but could affect late smoke checks. I'll notify infra and ops.
liam: Thanks. Canary plan: deploy canary commit -> run smoke (15m) -> check latency and error-rate. If error-rate >= 2.5x baseline or latency regresses >20% -> rollback. deploy-bot will post health updates here.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for commit abc123def -> canary-group. Health check kicks in, will report statuses every 5m.
olivia: ping @emma for review on config toggle. Small patch, should be quick
emma: Reviewing now. If CI green I can merge and queue the cherry.
sanjay: Fix branch CI started. If green, prefer to fold into this cut; if not, we'll follow up hotfix after deploy.
liam: Agreed — include it if green by T-30m. Otherwise proceed and hotfix. ops-team, please stand by for manual rollback if canary spikes.
ops-team: Standing by. We'll watch the canary channel and be ready to flip traffic.
liam: Quick rollback command (if needed):
```bash
./deployctl rollback --env prod --deploy-id canary-2026-03-17-abc123
```
liam: Ok, next updates in ~15m or earlier if anything pops. :thumbsup:
